Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S27 The summary call under provider faults (stubbed model): fallback inside parsePreRoundNotes, one sub-call failing, a model that never answers

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T4 The summary-failed state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's style (never a blank screen, crash, raw error pop-up or invented content), loses nothing typed or dictated, appears only af … (TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 2; TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-94745 AC 5; UAT Empty & Failure States; UAT 3.5)
  • U6 If the summary call fails: the raw dictation is kept, an explicit error shows, and Generate is disabled until a Save succeeds (PR #53). Yesterday's panels are never silently reused. (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 8; TFA-94745 state 3; UAT Empty & Failure States)
  • U11 Save Note timing: panels within 10-15 s, 15 s or less in at least 9/10 cycles (a target, not pass/fail; a run over 30 s not caused by the AI service is investigated). … (UAT 3.5; UAT 3.9)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given The bedrock.invoke stub harness from provider-fallback.spec.ts on the local backend; parsePreRoundNotes called with the S01 text and the Hospital context

When (a) Haiku throttles twice, then Mistral answers; (b) only the background prompt fails on every attempt; (c) only the diagnostics prompt fails on every attempt; (d) the provider never resolves

Then (a) The action returns the full result and the aiCallLog row fn=parsing.parsePreRoundNotes records Mistral with fellBackFrom Haiku. (b)/(c) The returned shape is recorded: whether the action throws, or returns background '' / radiology [] with nothing that tells the client a part failed. (d) The time until the action rejects is recorded; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright api assertions for (a) (T4: retried, then the backup model; 3.9: the model is logged) and for (d) rejecting at all within the test timeout. (b), (c) and the (d) duration are recorded and judged against Q14 and Q10: callJson in parsing.ts wraps chat() (Haiku, Haiku, Mistral) in its own 2-attempt loop with a 2.5 s wait, so one sub-call can make up to 6 attempts

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)
